hypothesis: Event-time observation may preserve a transient CEX-to-CLOB or CLOB-to-model discrepancy that a one-second sampler misses. Faster observation has value only if quote-survival-adjusted, post-fee PnL improves under identical order latency.

event.information_cadence: Binance or Polymarket event, coalesced at most 25ms per asset

assignment.stratification: reported by asset and UTC day; no post-hoc reassignment

primary_metrics: post-fee PnL per intended signal at 1x current fee model
event-minus-sampled arm difference with market/day clustered interval
decision_rule: No promotion or parameter change from this cohort before the minimum read. A faster arm is useful only if its clustered post-fee interval and quote-survival evidence improve; a null or negative result means the apparent latency edge is not deployable.
